options.label: PANDA
options.description: For “thresholded PANDA TF-to-gene edge list” · Widely used baseline: message passing over motif, PPI and co-expression evidence

options.description: For “thresholded PANDA TF-to-gene edge list” · One TF-gene network per sample, derived leave-one-out from the cohort

options.label: OTTER
options.description: For “thresholded PANDA TF-to-gene edge list” · Explicit objective (graph matching), fitted by a fixed number of gradient steps; lighter on memory

options.label: LIONESS-COEXPRESSION
options.description: For “gene-gene co-expression network” · One gene co-expression network per sample; needs only expression data

options.label: BONOBO
options.description: For “gene-gene co-expression network” · Per-sample co-expression with Bayesian shrinkage and a p-value per edge
